human.quote: I read your project myself. And I take care of it myself.

items.a: You have access to an AI and want to create it yourself: “I guide you” ({price}). You’d rather receive the finished result without doing anything: “I build it for you” ({priceCreation}).

items.q: What does “I build it for you” include?
items.a: One creation made by me, your choice: a one-page website, a video ad or a motion design animation up to {videoSeconds} seconds. Delivered by email within {deliveryHours} hours, ready to publish, with {revisionsIncluded}. Hosting and a domain name for a website are not included: I explain how to put it online.

items.q: Why is the price so low?
items.a: Because I create with AI: what used to take days now takes me a few hours. And the formats are deliberately short. If your request goes beyond them, I tell you before starting and refund you in full.

items.q: I’m a complete beginner. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. With “I guide you”, I adapt my explanations to your level. With “I build it for you”, there’s nothing to know: you describe, I build.

items.q: Do I need to pay for tools?
items.a: With “I guide you”, some tools are free, others paid: I tell you where to start depending on your budget. With “I build it for you”, there’s nothing to install and nothing extra to pay.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: You have a 14-day right of withdrawal, under the conditions set out in the terms of sale. By ordering, you ask me to start right away, and you lose this right once my reply or your creation has been fully delivered.
Yes. Payment is handled by Stripe. I never see your card details.
